title: wiki
summary: Looks up the dl:wiki concept topics a team has written into their own doc comments, and routes a human phrase to the code that implements it
intro: Read this when you have a human phrase such as the scheduler and want the code behind it: wiki routes the phrase to the symbol that a team has marked with a dl:wiki block, and can list or check all topics.

surfaces.usage: drag-lint wiki --term "<phrase>" | --list | --check [--json] [--db <file.sqlite>] (dl:wiki CONCEPT topics written in doc comments: --term routes a human word or alias ("the scheduler") to the owning symbol, --list prints every topic, --check resolves every SeeCode entry and exits 1 on drift. Authoring format: docs\wiki\Wiki-Blocks-Authoring.md)
help: drag-lint wiki --term "<phrase>" | --list | --check [--json] [--db <file.sqlite>]   (dl:wiki CONCEPT topics written in doc comments: --term routes a human word or alias ("the scheduler") to the owning symbol, --list prints every topic, --check resolves every SeeCode entry and exits 1 on drift. Authoring format: docs\wiki\Wiki-Blocks-Authoring.md)
